behavioral_effects: None stated. An empty list is a claim that nothing observably changes.
compatibility_impact: The four endpoints gain a 429 response (error code RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED, message surfaced through the login proxy detail extraction which now also reads the backend error envelope). Callers under the limits see no change. RedisClient gains incr_with_ttl; the shared test mock covers it. Limits are module constants in app/core/rate_limit.py, not env vars - a deliberate choice to keep the config surface flat; revisit if per-deployment tuning is ever needed.
reason: Security finding: the credential endpoints have no application-level rate limiting and the generic Traefik limit cannot see through the Next server-to-server proxy hop, leaving password guessing and email-flooding unthrottled; add Redis-backed counters keyed on forwarded client IP and target account
rollback: git revert removes the limiter module, route wiring, proxy forwarding, and tests as one unit; counters left in Redis expire on their own windows.
security_impact: Login, registration, password-reset request, and magic-link request now carry fixed-window Redis rate limits keyed on the forwarded client IP (login 10/5min, register 5/h, reset and magic-link 3/15min) and, where an account is targeted, on the lowercased account with half the allowance - so a distributed guesser is still pinned per account and email flooding is capped. The Next proxy forwards X-Forwarded-For on these four routes so the backend keys on the real client, closing the gap the finding named (Traefik cannot see through the server-to-server hop). Limits fail open with a warning when Redis is down: authentication availability is not tied to the cache. Live-verified against the running stack: sixth wrong-password attempt on one account returns 429 with real Redis. Counters use the ratelimit: prefix in Redis db 0 (general cache) - ephemeral window counters with cache semantics, noted here as db 0's consumer set grows.
summary: Rate-limit login, registration, password-reset and magic-link requests per client IP and per account
